COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
29.11.2023 CLR No. 174 of 2023
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. V.K. Kaparuwan, Advocate, for the 
revisionist. 
Mr. Tejas Aggarwal, Advocate, for the 
respondent.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
This is a SCC Revision, preferred under 
Section 25 of the Provincial Small Cause Courts 
Act.
Admit.
Summon the lower Court records.
List as soon as the records of the Court 
below are received.
There would be stay of eviction,
subject to the condition that the 
defendant/revisionist pays the entire 
decreetal amount within a period of one 
month from today and continue to pay the 
rent of the tenement in question by 10th of
each month. On the deposits being made by 
the revisionist, in compliance of today’s order, 
the respondent would be permitted to 
withdraw the amount, thus deposited by the 
revisionist in pursuance to today’s order.
Failing to comply with the aforesaid 
conditions, there would be an automatic 
vacation of the interim protection granted by 
this Court.
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 29.11.2023
Mahinder/
